:::{#exm-kronecker-outer-product}
#### An outer product as a Kronecker product

For $\vecf{u} = (1, 2, 3)$ and $\vecf{v} = (4, 5)$,
the [Kronecker product](#def-kronecker-product) of $\vecf{u}$ with $\tp{\vecf{v}}$ is

$$
\ba
\vecf{u} \otimes \tp{\vecf{v}}
&= \begin{bmatrix}
1 \cd \begin{bmatrix} 4 & 5 \end{bmatrix} \\
2 \cd \begin{bmatrix} 4 & 5 \end{bmatrix} \\
3 \cd \begin{bmatrix} 4 & 5 \end{bmatrix}
\end{bmatrix}
&& \text{(definition of the Kronecker product)}
\\
&= \begin{bmatrix}
4 & 5 \\
8 & 10 \\
12 & 15
\end{bmatrix}
&& \text{(multiply)}
\ea
$$

This is the [outer product](#def-outer-product) $\oprod{\vecf{u}}{\vecf{v}}$
that [the example of an outer product](#exm-outer-product) found,
as @thm-kronecker-outer-product says.
